name: Learn: Workloads — Jobs & CronJobs
objective: CKAD › Workloads & Scheduling. Drill the controller + batch surface: a Deployment's strategy/history, Jobs (completions/parallelism/backoffLimit/activeDeadline/ttl/Indexed), CronJobs (schedule/concurrencyPolicy/startingDeadline/history/suspend), and a no-hint parallelism diagnose-fix. Graded exactly.
description: Eight strict batch/controller practicals. Each Check shows which requirements you met and the reason for any you missed.

questions.title: Deployment: strategy + revision history
questions.teach:
A Deployment's `.spec.strategy.type` is `RollingUpdate` (default) or `Recreate` (kill all, then recreate — brief downtime). `.spec.revisionHistoryLimit` caps how many old ReplicaSets are kept for rollback.

**Gotcha:** `Recreate` must not carry a `rollingUpdate` block.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create a Deployment `web` (image `nginx:1.25`, 3 replicas, label `app=web`) with strategy `Recreate` and `revisionHistoryLimit: 5`.

Target: `web` has 3 replicas, strategy.type Recreate, revisionHistoryLimit 5.
questions.hint: Scaffold with `kubectl create deployment web --image=nginx:1.25 --replicas=3 --dry-run=client -o yaml`, then add `strategy.type: Recreate` and `revisionHistoryLimit: 5`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: { name: web, namespace: workloads-learn, labels: { app: web } }
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy: { type: Recreate }
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: web } }
  template:
    metadata: { labels: { app: web } }
    spec:
      containers: [ { name: web, image: nginx:1.25 } ]
YAML

questions.title: Job: completions + parallelism
questions.teach:
A **Job** runs pods to successful completion. `completions` = how many successes are needed; `parallelism` = how many run at once. A Job pod's `restartPolicy` must be `Never` or `OnFailure` (never `Always`).

**Gotcha:** the API rejects a Job whose pod `restartPolicy` is `Always`.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create a Job `pi` that reaches **6** successful completions running **2** at a time, image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'exit 0'`, `restartPolicy: Never`.

Target: Job `pi` has completions 6, parallelism 2, restartPolicy Never.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: { name: pi, namespace: workloads-learn }
spec:
  completions: 6
  parallelism: 2
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers: [ { name: pi, image: busybox:1.36, command: ["sh","-c","exit 0"] } ]
YAML

verification.description: Job pi: completions 6, parallelism 2, restartPolicy Never

questions.title: Job: backoffLimit + OnFailure
questions.teach:
`backoffLimit` is how many times a Job retries a failed pod before it's marked Failed (default 6). With `restartPolicy: OnFailure` the **container** restarts in place; with `Never` a new **pod** is created per retry.

**Gotcha:** `OnFailure` restarts the container (same pod); `Never` spawns fresh pods — both count against `backoffLimit`.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create a Job `retry` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'exit 0'`) with `backoffLimit: 4` and `restartPolicy: OnFailure`.

Target: Job `retry` has backoffLimit 4 and pod restartPolicy OnFailure.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: { name: retry, namespace: workloads-learn }
spec:
  backoffLimit: 4
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: OnFailure
      containers: [ { name: c, image: busybox:1.36, command: ["sh","-c","exit 0"] } ]
YAML

questions.title: Job: deadline + auto-cleanup
questions.teach:
`activeDeadlineSeconds` caps a Job's total runtime (it's marked Failed/`DeadlineExceeded` past it). `ttlSecondsAfterFinished` auto-deletes the Job that many seconds after it finishes.

**Gotcha:** `activeDeadlineSeconds` bounds wall-clock time and overrides `backoffLimit`; `ttl` cleanup starts only once the Job has completed/failed.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create a Job `bounded` (image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'sleep 3600'`, `restartPolicy: Never`) with `activeDeadlineSeconds: 300` and `ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 30`.

Target: Job `bounded` has activeDeadlineSeconds 300 and ttlSecondsAfterFinished 30.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: { name: bounded, namespace: workloads-learn }
spec:
  activeDeadlineSeconds: 300
  ttlSecondsAfterFinished: 30
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers: [ { name: c, image: busybox:1.36, command: ["sh","-c","sleep 3600"] } ]
YAML

questions.title: Indexed Job
questions.teach:
`completionMode: Indexed` gives each of the `completions` pods a unique index (0..N-1) in `$JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX` — for partitioned/parallel work where each worker handles its slice.

**Gotcha:** default `completionMode` is `NonIndexed`; Indexed needs `completions` set and each index must succeed once.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create an **Indexed** Job `indexed` (`completionMode: Indexed`) with `completions: 4`, `parallelism: 2`, image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'exit 0'`, `restartPolicy: Never`.

Target: Job `indexed` has completionMode Indexed, completions 4, parallelism 2.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata: { name: indexed, namespace: workloads-learn }
spec:
  completionMode: Indexed
  completions: 4
  parallelism: 2
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers: [ { name: c, image: busybox:1.36, command: ["sh","-c","exit 0"] } ]
YAML

verification.description: Job indexed: completionMode Indexed, completions 4, parallelism 2

questions.title: CronJob: schedule + concurrencyPolicy
questions.teach:
A **CronJob** creates a Job on a cron `schedule`. `concurrencyPolicy` handles overlap: `Allow` (default), `Forbid` (skip if the previous run is still going), or `Replace`.

**Gotcha:** the Job pod `restartPolicy` lives under `jobTemplate.spec.template.spec`, and must be `Never`/`OnFailure`.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create a CronJob `report` with schedule `*/5 * * * *`, `concurrencyPolicy: Forbid`, whose Job runs image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'date'`, `restartPolicy: Never`.

Target: CronJob `report` has schedule `*/5 * * * *` and concurrencyPolicy Forbid.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: report, namespace: workloads-learn }
spec:
  schedule: "*/5 * * * *"
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          containers: [ { name: c, image: busybox:1.36, command: ["sh","-c","date"] } ]
YAML

questions.title: CronJob: suspend, deadline, history
questions.teach:
`suspend: true` stops a CronJob from creating new Jobs. `startingDeadlineSeconds` is how late a missed run may still start. `successfulJobsHistoryLimit`/`failedJobsHistoryLimit` cap how many finished Jobs are kept.

**Gotcha:** `suspend: true` pauses future runs but doesn't stop a Job already running.
questions.prompt:
In `workloads-learn`, create a **suspended** CronJob `nightly` (schedule `0 2 * * *`, image `busybox:1.36`, command `sh -c 'date'`, restartPolicy Never) with `suspend: true`, `startingDeadlineSeconds: 60`, `successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 2`, `failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1`.

Target: CronJob `nightly` has suspend true, startingDeadlineSeconds 60, and those history limits.
questions.hint: Set `suspend: true`, `startingDeadlineSeconds: 60`, `successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 2`, `failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1` under the CronJob spec.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata: { name: nightly, namespace: workloads-learn }
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  suspend: true
  startingDeadlineSeconds: 60
  successfulJobsHistoryLimit: 2
  failedJobsHistoryLimit: 1
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          restartPolicy: Never
          containers: [ { name: c, image: busybox:1.36, command: ["sh","-c","date"] } ]
YAML

verification.description: CronJob nightly: suspend true, startingDeadline 60, history 2/1

questions.title: Diagnose & fix: a Job that never runs
questions.teach:
A Job stuck at **0 completions with no pods** usually has `parallelism: 0` (effectively paused) — unlike Deployments, a Job's `parallelism` is mutable, so you patch it up to resume.

**Gotcha:** `kubectl describe job` shows 0 active/0 succeeded with no pod events; patch `parallelism` (not the immutable pod template) to get it moving.
questions.prompt:
Job `stuck` in `workloads-learn` was created but **no pods run and it never completes**. Diagnose why and fix it so the Job completes. Don't delete it.

Target: Job `stuck` reaches its completions (succeeded ≥ 3).
questions.hint: `kubectl -n workloads-learn get job stuck` shows 0/3 with no pods; `kubectl -n workloads-learn get job stuck -o jsonpath='{.spec.parallelism}'` → 0. Patch it: `kubectl -n workloads-learn patch job stuck -p '{"spec":{"parallelism":2}}'`.
questions.solution:
kubectl -n workloads-learn patch job stuck -p '{"spec":{"parallelism":2}}'
kubectl -n workloads-learn get job stuck -w
